findings.summary: The merge uses how="inner", so orders whose customer_id is missing from segments are silently dropped, making total revenue across segments lower than actual revenue.

judge.reason: Describes the known inner-join dropping of orders without segment rows.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: If segments has multiple rows per customer_id, the merge duplicates orders and their revenue is double-counted; there is no deduplication or validate="many_to_one" guard.

judge.reason: Identifies duplication of orders and double-counted revenue from multiple segment rows per customer in the merge.

findings.label: hit
